Locally bundled, unmodified browser distributions (MIT licensed):

@xterm/xterm 6.0.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/xterm/-/xterm-6.0.0.tgz
Files: lib/xterm.js, css/xterm.css, LICENSE (xterm.LICENSE)

@xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/addon-fit/-/addon-fit-0.11.0.tgz
Files: lib/addon-fit.js, LICENSE (addon-fit.LICENSE)

Upstream: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
API references: https://xtermjs.org/docs/ and https://xtermjs.org/docs/guides/using-addons/
These assets are served from localhost. No CDN or remote scripts are loaded.
Source maps are intentionally not shipped; runtime does not require them.
